st: Is OpenAI o3 with a Swiss army knife AGI?

sec.t: ff.123.1 The AI with a Swiss army knife
sec.p: When Tyler Cowen (theorist of the “great stagnation”, 🤔 ff.50.1 The oddness of the last 50 years) says he saw AGI (or a porno) on 16 April 2025, you have to stop and pay attention.
In all this, humans are increasingly the limiting factor. The bottleneck.

sec.t: ff.123.3 The new GeoGuessr champion: o3
sec.p: To show off its ability to combine various tools, maps included, the ever-reliable Ethan Mollick had o3 play GeoGuessr.
Since we're talking about AI, back to the Ghibli craze.
